name: Feishu Connector
description: Webhook-driven Feishu connector skeleton for OpenSoha events and bot actions.

config.name: appSecret
config.description: Feishu custom app secret used to fetch tenant_access_token.

config.name: verificationToken
config.description: Verification token configured in Feishu event subscriptions.

config.name: encryptKey
config.description: Encrypt Key used for X-Lark-Signature verification and encrypted event payloads.

config.name: baseUrl
config.description: Feishu Open Platform API base URL.

config.name: autoReplyEnabled
config.description: Enable local auto-reply for message event smoke tests.

config.name: retryMax
config.description: Maximum outbound action retries for retryable Feishu API failures.

config.name: actionRateLimitPerMinute
config.description: Fixed-window outbound action limit per connector process.

config.name: reliabilityDir
config.description: Optional writable directory for file-backed idempotency and dead-letter persistence.

config.name: retryQueueMax
config.description: Maximum file-backed retry queue entries retained when reliabilityDir is enabled.

secrets.purpose: Webhook signature verification and event decryption.

capabilities.name: webhook.verify
capabilities.description: Verifies URL challenge, Verification Token, and X-Lark-Signature.

capabilities.name: event.im.message.receive_v1
capabilities.description: Normalizes Feishu message events into OpenSoha connector events.

capabilities.name: action.message.send_text
capabilities.description: Sends a text message through the Feishu bot identity.

capabilities.name: runtime.http
capabilities.description: Exposes health, manifest, webhook, action, and dead-letter HTTP endpoints.

capabilities.name: runtime.reliability.memory
capabilities.description: Provides in-memory webhook idempotency, action rate limiting, retry, and dead-letter state.

capabilities.name: runtime.reliability.file
capabilities.description: Provides optional file-backed retry queue, idempotency, and dead-letter persistence when SOHA_FEISHU_RELIABILITY_DIR is set.

capabilities.name: runtime.metrics
capabilities.description: Exposes webhook, duplicate, action, retry, and dead-letter counters through the HTTP runtime.

permissions.description: Read and send IM messages when the app needs full message access.
Send messages as the Feishu bot for connector actions.

actions.name: feishu.message.send_text
actions.description: Send a text message to a chat, user, union, email, or open ID recipient.
